[LEXP.3.9.1] Each function below is a member of `math` ([LIMP.3.3.4]). Each takes `Float` arguments, an `Int` argument being
converted to `Float`, and returns a `Float`. An `angle` argument is its value in
radians ([LUNI.4.2]).

| Function | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `exp(x)` | $e^x$ |
| `ln(x)` | $\ln x$, the natural logarithm |
| `log2(x)` | $\log_2 x$ |
| `log10(x)` | $\log_{10} x$ |
| `sin(x)` `cos(x)` `tan(x)` | the trigonometric functions of `x` radians |
| `asin(x)` `acos(x)` `atan(x)` | the inverse trigonometric functions, in radians |
| `atan2(y, x)` | the angle of the point $(x, y)$ from the positive $x$ axis, in radians, in $[-\pi, \pi]$ |
| `sinh(x)` `cosh(x)` `tanh(x)` | the hyperbolic functions |

`math.pow(x, y)` and `**` are [LEXP.3.2]'s and [LEXP.7.3a]'s; with a `Float`
result they are a transcendental function of this section too.
